aids.title: 📦 Magic Variables Box game
aids.desc: An interactive game that explains to children how a variable stores a single value in memory and how the value changes when a new value is entered. Drag the values ​​and place them in the box to experiment with the customization (x = 5).

aids.title: 🚦 Traffic light police game (If/Else)
aids.desc: Fun simulation for explaining conditional sentences; Control the traffic light to show when the car stops (if red: stop) and when to go (else: go) with interactive sounds.

aids.title: 🔄 Looping and wrapping factory (For/While Loops)
aids.desc: Trigger the robot to wrap 5 gifts in a row using the loop (for i in range(5)) to see the interactive timer step by step.
